notes: Build 57 — Camera: Live Rotate + Landscape Stamp Darmiyan Me. Camera khula ho to screen sensor se ghoomti hai: phone landscape karo to live preview, stamp aur buttons sab us taraf ghoom jate hain, chahe system auto-rotate off ho. Landscape photo par stamp neeche beech me poori chaudai par lagti hai, jo live dikhe wahi saved photo me aayega.
